exposure: myometrial thickness adjacent to the defect
distance from the defect to the external cervical os
outcome: Clinical cure rate of AUB following hysteroscopic therapy
cohort: 147 women who underwent hysteroscopic surgery for PCSD-related AUB at the Gynecology Department of Third Xiangya Hospital of Central South University from 2018 to 2022
finding: The myometrial thickness adjacent to the defect and the distance from the defect to the external cervical os on preoperative MRI are risk factors for clinical cure rate in patients with PCSD-related AUB after hysteroscopic treatment.
mod_finding: Preoperative MRI findings, particularly myometrial thickness adjacent to the defect and distance from the defect to the external cervical os, can predict the likelihood of clinical cure after hysteroscopic treatment for PCSD-related AUB.
